summary: Corporación América Airports S.A. (NYSE: CAAP), a Luxembourg-domiciled airport operator, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 16, 2026 reporting August 2026 passenger traffic. Total traffic fell 0.9% year over year to 7.871 million passengers, with domestic down 7.4% and international up 4.5%; year-to-date total rose 2.4%. Management attributed Argentine weakness to reduced capacity, notably Flybondi's contraction, partly offset by Aerolíneas Argentinas and JetSMART reallocation. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation.
